title: PipeshubCitationSource
description: Where a citation's content came from (P1b C-18), as a typed reference. A shared viewer's access is decided per kind: a record's own ACL (indexed, attachment, generated), the ACL of the indexed copy of the same item (live), or none (web). A live source never names a record: the id of the temporary record a tool built is not a record reference.

RecordSource.title: PipeshubRecordSource
RecordSource.description: A record in the graph: indexed from a connector or a knowledge base, a file uploaded into the conversation (attachment), or an artifact a run produced (generated).

virtualRecordId.description: The stored content an attachment reference names (its virtualRecordId, what a worker reads the file by): readable only when it is this record's own (C-21, steering attachments).

publicationId.description: The knowledge publication (D21, P2.13) through which an indexed record reached the turn when its reader could not read it themselves. A viewer may then see the source when they can read the record, or while that publication still discloses it to them; never anyone outside its audience.

LiveSource.title: PipeshubLiveSource
LiveSource.description: A file a tool fetched directly from a connector with the run owner's credentials. connector is the source system's connector kind (a Connectors value); connectorId the instance that fetched it, when known.

WebSource.title: PipeshubWebSource
WebSource.description: A public web page. Names no record and is shown to every viewer.

SourceId.description: An identifier as the source system writes it (record keys, connector kinds such as 'SHAREPOINT ONLINE', drive item ids).
